info.description: The BeatPass API provides access to platform data for approved developer integrations. API access is invite-only — contact contact@beatpass.ca to request access. Authenticate with a Bearer token. Tokens expire after 90 days. Unauthenticated requests return minimal data (e.g. id, name, image, model_type, and basic metadata). Global rate limit: 300 requests/minute.
